test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If P can finish a job in 3 hours and Q can finish the same job in 6 hours independently, then they together will finish the job in x minutes. Find the value of x .
solution:
**Given:**

P can finish a job in 3 hours.

Q can finish the same job in 6 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by P in 1 hour = 1/3

Work done by Q in 1 hour = 1/6

Total work done by P and Q in 1 hour together = Work done by P in 1 hour + Work done by Q in 1 hour

**Calculation:**

Work done by P in 1 hour = 1/3

Work done by Q in 1 hour = 1/6

Total work done by P and Q in 1 hour together = 1/3 + 1/6

Total work done by P and Q in 1 hour together = 2/6 + 1/6</p&
